shorts.title:
Lice tell us when humans
started wearing clothes

We wore jewelry before
we wore clothes?

The fez, the hat,
and the law

High heels were
invented for men

Can a lab coat change
how you think?

The real cost of
fast fashion

Try this: what is
your outfit saying?
